note: Defect log for the Software Test Report (v1.0, tested version v1.0.1-test / 1d45c59). Not yet mirrored as GitHub Issues.

defects.title: Tourist can set any refund amount when cancelling a pre-order
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite (PostgreSQL 17), Windows 11, base commit 72586ab
steps: Log in as a tourist with a pre-order in vendor_accepted
defects.expected: Refund computed by the server from the configured policy (SRS §5.3: prevent unauthorised modification of payment records; FR-34)
defects.actual: refundAmount 99999 stored and shown as the refund
defects.rootCause: preorders_update copied refundAmount from any participant's request body into the row (generic field map) without a role check.

defects.title: Tourist can cancel a pre-order after preparation has started
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite, Windows 11, base 72586ab
steps: Vendor moves a pre-order to preparing
Tourist sends status cancelled with a reason
defects.expected: Refused: cancellation only before preparation begins (FR-34, SRS §4.2.6)
defects.actual: 200 OK, pre-order cancelled and advance marked refunded
defects.evidence: regression-before-after.txt: TC-92 'Failed asserting that an array contains 200'
defects.rootCause: PREORDER_TRANSITIONS allowed cancelled from every non-final state for every participant; no tourist-specific rule.

defects.title: Refund amount not calculated from the configured refund percentage
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite, Windows 11, base 72586ab
defects.evidence: regression-before-after.txt: 'Failed asserting that null matches expected 240'
defects.rootCause: Known limitation (SRS §6.5): settings were stored but never applied on cancellation.

defects.title: Rejected vendor account stays active
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite, Windows 11, base 72586ab
defects.expected: Login refused: rejection suspends the account (FR-04, SRS §4.5)
defects.evidence: regression-before-after.txt: TC-29 'Failed asserting that 200 is identical to 403'
defects.rootCause: admin_vendor_verify always set status = 'active'; the guide version set 'suspended' on rejection.

defects.title: Reporting a guide payment fails on PostgreSQL
defects.foundBy: Code review while building the guide cash flow
steps: Tourist reports a cash payment for a finished tour (POST /api/guide-payments)
defects.actual: 500: INSERT used the double-quoted "reported", which PostgreSQL reads as a column name
defects.rootCause: MySQL-only SQL (double-quoted string literal) missed in the PostgreSQL migration.

defects.title: Bengali names shown as garbled text (mojibake)
defects.foundBy: User report; data scan of the live API
defects.fix: data fix on Supabase (79 values) + 8bf0f55 (fonts, dump command)
steps: Open a place or local food page
defects.evidence: Scan of 79 live items: 0 garbled after fix; TC-123 asserts Bengali script
defects.rootCause: The XAMPP dump was written through the Windows console (code page 437).

defects.title: PHP warnings leak into API responses
steps: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with a registered e-mail while no mail server is reachable
defects.expected: Same JSON message as for an unknown e-mail; no server details (OWASP misconfiguration)
defects.actual: HTML warning with the server path printed before the JSON; reveals which e-mails are registered
defects.evidence: regression-before-after.txt: TC-16 'two strings are identical' failure
defects.rootCause: The API relied on php.ini to hide errors (production image happens to hide them).

defects.title: Pre-order settings accept out-of-range values
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite, Windows 11, base 72586ab
defects.rootCause: No server-side validation of the settings form.

defects.title: API smoke test out of date after required payment proof
defects.rootCause: Test not updated with the API change in 8bf0f55.

defects.title: Place reviews cannot be submitted
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite; also production
steps: Tourist POST /api/reviews {targetType: place, targetId: p1, rating: 5, content}
defects.expected: 201 (FR-39: reviews for places, products and guides)
defects.actual: 422 'Place reviews require a verified visit record, which is not supported yet.'
defects.rootCause: Design choice to require a visit record that does not exist yet.

defects.title: No tracking number or automatic 5-day delivery estimate
defects.env: PHP 8.2.35 API on PGlite; also production
steps: Tourist checks out a delivery order
defects.expected: Tracking number and estimated delivery = placement + 5 days (SRS §4.4, FR-36)
defects.actual: trackingNumber null; estimatedDelivery null until the vendor sets it
defects.rootCause: Implementation changed to vendor-set delivery dates; SRS not updated.

defects.title: No audit log of user and payment events
Accessibility: low contrast, unnamed icon buttons/links, unlabelled selects
steps: Run Lighthouse accessibility on the six key pages
defects.actual: color-contrast, button-name, link-name, select-name, heading-order, target-size
defects.rootCause: Icon-only controls without aria-label; muted text colours below 4.5:1.

defects.title: API accepts requests from any origin (CORS *)
defects.expected: CORS restricted to the production frontend (SRS §5.3)
defects.rootCause: CORS_ORIGIN not set on Render; the code defaults to * (SRS §6.5).

defects.title: No clickjacking / MIME-sniffing / CSP headers on the site
defects.expected: X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (OWASP security misconfiguration)

defects.title: API returns 502 for about a minute after each deploy
defects.env: Production: Vercel /api proxy → Render free plan
defects.actual: 502 Bad Gateway for every request for ~1 minute
defects.evidence: First p95 run: 300/300 errors; re-run after deploy: 0/300
defects.rootCause: Render free plan has no zero-downtime deploy for this service.
